findings.reason: W3C high-precision D65 direct conversion and pinned Skia D50/ICC float32 route differ across an eight-bit rounding boundary; do not adjust tolerance or inject input-specific constants.
findings.sourcePath: Chromium156 color.cc:156,567,608,819 and ui/gfx/color_conversions.cc:263; Skia SkColorSpace.h:214-241
findings.implementation: Generic Display P3 family now evaluates source float32 transfer, D50 matrix, inverse source ICC sRGB matrix, inverse source transfer and existing final byte rounding.

findings.reason: 2026 W3C sample switched to pure BT.1886 gamma2.4. Fixed Chromium156/Skia retains piecewise BT.2020 inverse OETF, matching older W3C 2022 section10.6/appendix code. These are different transfer definitions, not acceptable floating error.
findings.sourcePath: Pinned Skia SkColorSpace.h:128; Chromium skcms_ext.cc:17-66; W3C2022 rec2020 section
findings.implementation: Rec2020 family uses (g,a,b,c,d,e,f)=(2.22222,.909672,.0903276,.222222,.0812429,0,0), same source D50/ICC path and float32 operations.

fixedHostColorRepair.licenseNotes: New host-specific scalar/matrix adaptation is sourced from Chromium/Skia BSD files. Exact Chromium and Skia LICENSE artifacts included; root owns bundled licenses/notice integration. This adds no runtime library/Canvas/JS dependency.
